values.meaning: current cooldown reduced if it hits an enemy
values.quote: ''Body Slam's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 40% if '''Gragas''' hits an enemy.

mechanics.claim: Gragas dashes in the target direction and stops upon colliding with an enemy, dealing damage to all nearby enemies, knocking them back, and stunning them.
mechanics.quote: '''Gragas''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction and stops upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Barrel Roll and Explosive Cask can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Barrel Roll|Gragas}} and {{ai|Explosive Cask|Gragas}} can be cast during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: Flash can be cast during Body Slam, instantly ending it and affecting enemies at the flash location.
mechanics.quote: {{si|Flash}} can be casted during ''Body Slam'', instantly ending it and affecting enemies at the flash location.
